blocks.text:
JavaScript has a built in error object that provides error information when
an error occurs.
The error object provides useful properties like name and message.

rows: Sets or returns an error name
Sets or returns an error message
Sets or returns an error cause
Returns true if a value (x) is an Error

blocks.text: Six different values can be returned by the error name property:

rows: A number "out of range" has occurred
An error in encodeURI() has occurred
